t: A tiny USB 3 logic analyzer that shows the signals inside your gadgets.
steps: Buy the basic or advanced package from Sipeed's AliExpress store.
Download Sipeed's PulseView build from the SLogic user guide.
Plug the analyzer into a direct USB 3 port with a USB 3 cable.
Connect a ground clip to your circuit's ground first.
Clip channel 0 onto a blinking LED pin on a microcontroller board.
Press Run in PulseView and watch the pulses appear.
Add a UART or I2C decoder to read real data.
